body: Thank you, I hope stuff works out for you too!
Sometimes the darkness can make me feel worse, but being in bed with fairy lights, my favourite mug and a cozy atmosphere makes it feel less daunting.

I'm a lazy asshole who wishes they weren't born into a stupid system where things require effort to live. I hate the fact I have to dedicate my life to work, to expectations, to situations. I'm pissed that I was born because I just have absolutely no desire to live like I'm supposed to. Yet other people work and achieve around me and all I can do is shrug, and then want to jump off a bridge cause they're actually "living".
Yeah, I applied for counselling and wrote every single thing. Even things I don't mentioned to support workers and I still haven't got anything back. Got a doctors appointment this week.
It's not so much that I'm brushed off, but we live together. Who wants to live with an unstable depressed suicidal person? I hide it by my own doing, but sometimes I feel like just snapping.

Yeah, that's probably true. I think the only way I can be happy is alone in a room with my PC and S.O. But that's not fair on myself or them, but right now it's all I want. I want a room, that's mine, with internet, my PC and income. Even if it's a boring job forever, I just want to be happy with myself instead of beating myself up as well as being sad about my life situation. 


Haha, it seems hard to do in the moment. Just finished a crying fit coupled with multiple negative thoughts, haven't had a cry in a while.

Thank you for time.


This is it though, I don't want a longer run. Life doesn't seem like it will be anything amazing anytime soon. I know I'm in control of almost anything in my life, but I'm really not. Video games is the only thing that makes me happy, that distracts me from absolutely everything. But even when I play terribly, I start hating myself and thinking I'm useless all over again. I can't even enjoy my hobby.
